Name: Various Coal Ores (1.6)
Description:
Original mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14496?]Various Coal Ores by [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57738441]Dojando[/url]
﻿All Credits go to him, including assets. All I did was update the mod to use the new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions Framework[/url]﻿.

This mod adds different Variations of Coal ore into the mines, as well as three other nodes.

Those Variations Include the default stone one added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966]Custom Ore Nodes[/url] mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url] but also a lava rock and ice rock version for better looks, as well as a pure coal ore node that drops some extra coal. 

The 3 other nodes, that are inspired by "Gems and Ore Nodes" are:

[spoiler]
[list=1]
[*][b]Mudstone[/b]: Drops clay, with the chance of dropping an actual Mudstone
[*][b]Obsidian[/b]: Drops Obsidian. Has a 1 in 10 chance to also drop a diamond
[*][b]Prismatic [/b]Ore: Drops a prismatic shard.
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4]Installation (Vortex)[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20357]Item Extensions Framework[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿﻿ (Optional if you don't want to change the configurations for the mod)

[*]Install the mod.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url]

[/list][size=4]Configuration
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=2]Configuration can now be done via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/size][size=3], [/size][size=2]simple enough, 0.00 means it won't spawn and 1.00 means every stone in the floor range (indicated by the configuration name and in the tooltip) will become of that stone.[/size][size=4]

[/size][size=2]But it can also be done manually.

[/size][list=1]
[*][size=2]To do this access the mod folder, usually it should be in the same directory as the game (Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods for the defaut steam install location)[/size]
[*][size=2]Open file called content.json with the text editor of your choice (notepad, vscode, notepad++ or something similar)[/size]
[*][size=2]Find the ore you want to edit. [/size]

[*][size=2]If you want to edit the chances, find the floors you want to edit (In case of the common coal ore, there's 3 levels, from floors 1-20, 21 to 39 and 121 to -999, floors above 120 apply to skull cavern levels)[/size]
[*][size=2]Change the SpawnFrequency value, which ranges from 1 (all stones will be converter to coal ores) or 0 (no coal ores) this can be a small value like 0.005 which would mean 0.5% of stones in that floor range would become coal ores.[/size]

[/list]
